definitions: Of a somewhat high temperature, often but not always connoting that the high temperature is pleasant rather than uncomfortable.
To become warm, to heat up.

blocks.text: Woolen or woollen is a type of yarn made from carded wool. Woolen yarn is soft, light, stretchy, and full of air. It is thus a good insulator, and makes a good knitting yarn. Woolen yarn is in contrast to worsted yarn, in which the fibers are combed to lie parallel rather than carded, producing a hard, strong yarn.
